description: Reconcile the classifier registry against work already done — flip wip rules to fixed when a fix-bearing task-scoped commit lands, flag drift from published classifier_regressions and dispatch one classifier-fixer agent per drifted rule, and promote rules to permanent. Drives reconcile_registry.ts, the registry's only human-invoked writer, run deliberately by the human through atomic_update_registry.

flows.name: Detect mechanical registry transitions → human-confirmed status flips
flows.description: Detect mechanical registry transitions → human-confirmed status flips
intentions: Every registry write goes through atomic_update_registry — one lock-fenced read-mutate-write per invocation; this skill's script is the only human-invoked writer of registry.json.

The human confirms every status transition: the script detects the mechanical arrows (landed fix, published drift) and proposes them under --dry-run; it never runs on the autonomous sweep and never makes the permanent judgment.

function_name must be in core's BUILTIN_CHECKS: --promote refuses a rule whose builtin is dangling, and name-mode --fixed refuses to delete a row whose builtin is still registered (code-side deletion + core rebuild must land first).

A fixed row carries no drift_detected — the wip → fixed detector cites the newest matching fix/feat commit subject as its audit line; no commit hash is stored, the backlog_task link plus git log are the audit trail.
Idempotent apply: all proposals fold into one atomic_update_registry transaction; a re-run degrades already-absorbed proposals to nothing and reports applied: false.

The classifier-fixer agent edits only check_<group_id>.ts and its test — ordinary source edits behind a fixability-first triage (captured / fixable-in-Ariadne / mis-classified); every registry write stays with the script, and the skill runs one gated core rebuild + builtins test pass after the fixer wave.

flows.name: Insert a classifier-author draft (creation → wip)
intentions: Every registry write goes through atomic_update_registry — --stage --apply folds the insertion under the same lock; --stage is dry-run by default.
observed_count >= 1 evidence gate: the draft is validated against the KnownIssue schema, which enforces the evidence gate; a duplicate group_id is rejected (no silent overwrite).

function_name must be in core's BUILTIN_CHECKS: the draft's builtin function_name must be present in the built core package, and the drafted check must pass against every persisted EnrichedEntryPoint sample before --apply.

The human confirms every status transition: a staged entry enters as status wip; promotion to permanent remains the separate --promote step. The classifier-author agent writes only the staging draft, never registry.json.

stores.semantic_role: the loop-closure surface: one KnownIssue row per permanent-limitation classifier group. reconcile_registry.ts is the registry's only human-invoked writer and reaches it solely through atomic_update_registry(path, mutator) — a .lock-fenced read-mutate-write per invocation. writer_owner is null because this skill IS the registry's write path; the human confirms every status transition (the script detects and proposes, never decides).

the bundled core slice of permanent-limitation rules, regenerated via generate_permanent_data.ts on every --promote and every name-mode run (crash-recoverable by re-running the same command). permanent_data.sync.test.ts asserts the committed slice byte-equals a fresh render so it cannot silently drift. writer_owner null: this skill's script is the regenerator.

read-only landed-fix signal for the wip → fixed detector: the bare task scope of each wip rule's backlog_task (TASK-198 → 198) is matched exactly against fix/feat commit subjects in this repo's git log (range scopes like 190.17.12-14 expand to exact ids). No backlog/tasks/*.md file is read — the backlog_task link lives in the registry rows themselves.

read-only drift signal: each project's latest finalized run's classifier_regressions[] names registry rules by rule_id (= group_id); the drift detector proposes drift_detected: true plus append-only drift_evidence[] rows carrying {project, run_id} provenance, deduped by (project, entry_index). read, never written by this skill.

read-only per-rule fixer verdicts: each dispatched classifier-fixer records one terminal state per adjudicated drift_evidence case (captured / fixable-in-ariadne / mis-classified) plus skipped cases. The skill reads the verdicts to surface backlog proposals and classifier-author hand-offs to the human; the resume-skip keys on verdicts.json existence.

read-only staging input for --stage: the classifier-author agent (prioritize, step 3a) writes a KnownIssue draft plus its EnrichedEntryPoint samples here, never to the registry. --stage reads and validates the draft and executes the drafted builtin against the persisted samples before --apply inserts it as status wip.

sub_agents.multiplicity: one per rule with an applied drift_detected proposal, dispatched in parallel after the --drift apply; resume-skip on an existing verdicts.json. Edits only check_<group_id>.ts + its test; never writes registry.json. disable-model-invocation:true.
